title: AI Agent for Food Labeling: Automate B2B Nutritional Compliance
body:
Does every new product delay your sales due to labeling bureaucracy?

Changing a single ingredient in your product's formula means weeks of waiting. You have to recalculate the nutritional table, review allergen regulations, and ensure health claims comply with European law. For SMEs and B2B manufacturers, this bottleneck paralyzes innovation, slows down launches, and skyrockets external consulting costs.

The trap of spreadsheet calculations

Many producers rely on manual spreadsheets or outdated databases to cross-reference ingredient percentages. A simple decimal error can end up in a massive supermarket recall, catastrophic fines, and loss of reputation. Your food safety cannot depend on copy and paste.

Our solution: AI Labeling and Regulatory Compliance Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO, we have developed an Artificial Intelligence Agent that audits your recipes in real time, cross-referencing your bill of materials with official health databases and European regulations to generate technical labeling autonomously.

  1. Formulation analysis: The AI reads your production documents and extracts the exact ingredients, quantities, and additives.
  2. Automatic nutritional calculation: Generates the nutritional values table per 100g instantly with nanometric precision.
  3. Allergen and trace detection: Automatically identifies the 14 mandatory declaration allergens, drafting the legal warning.
  4. Technical sheet generation: Exports a PDF or sends the data via API to your ERP, ready to print and send to packaging.

The Real Impact on your Production Line

  • Express launches: Go from lab testing to packaging design in a matter of minutes, not weeks.
  • Zero risk of fines: Ensures strict compliance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 without relying on manual reviews.
  • Massive savings on consulting: Eliminates recurring fees from external laboratories for minor formulation changes.
